conceptZh: 披紅斗篷的小玩具機器人蹲低要來個超級起飛，結果只彈起一點點；就在他不好意思的時候，一隻小烏龜玩具「咻」地高速從他旁邊衝過去，還回頭看他一眼。
object: a small caped toy robot hero and a tiny wind-up toy tortoise
morph: the glyph 超 stands still as a solid sculpture while the super-jump gag plays out along its base
creativeAngle: 對應孩子喜歡的超人／英雄：用「自以為超快卻被烏龜超車」的反差笑點演出「超越」的字義，比單純變形更能讓他記住意思。超有走部與召部共十二畫，讓字體靜止保結構。語音詞「超人」，超ㄔㄠ、人ㄖㄣˊ都是單一讀音，人也已經學過。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale warm grey background. One correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 超 stands centered the whole time as a flat-fronted sculpture in saturated deep crimson red, filling about 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins on all sides. Use standard textbook proportions: the 走 radical wrapping the lower left and the 召 component sitting to its upper right stay clearly separated, with every stroke and hook readable. The glyph never moves, rotates, tilts or gets covered, and the camera stays locked. Along its base stands a small boxy toy robot hero with round friendly eyes and a short red cape. From 0.6 seconds he winds up with enormous determination, crouching lower and lower, cape flaring, clearly preparing for a colossal super-jump. At 1.9 seconds he launches - and rises only about the height of his own head before landing again with a soft parp. He freezes in the landing pose, embarrassed, and pats his cape flat. At 3.0 seconds a tiny wind-up toy tortoise streaks in from the left at absurd speed, whizzes straight past him along the bottom of frame, brakes briefly at the right edge to glance back at him, then zips out of shot. The little hero slowly turns his head to follow it, visor wide. At 4.5 seconds he shrugs, gives the camera a brave little salute, and hops out of frame to the left. From 4.7 to 8.0 seconds the frame is completely still and clean, holding on the single centered 超 with nothing else in shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「超、超、超人」, using the reading ㄔㄠ for 超 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 超 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 超人 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 超: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 兔子魔術師想從帽子裡拉出小小的字，卻拉出超大的「超」，帽子還反彈套住自己的頭。
object: An original, theatrical cartoon magician rabbit, its purple top hat, and one solid coral-red 超 glyph.
morph: A tiny rigid 超 rises from the hat and enlarges uniformly into the final centered glyph; the hat stretches around its base, then recoils onto the rabbit's head.
creativeAngle: 改用魔術失控的尺寸笑點，取代先前的跳躍競速。整個字只做等比例放大，不拆筆畫；帽子反彈遮住兔子的眼睛，兔子掀帽偷看後得意謝幕，留下完整清楚的字。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D animation in one locked, front-facing shot, with a pale cream background, soft studio lighting, and saturated coral-red lettering. The original lead is a cartoon magician rabbit with plush lavender fur, long expressive ears, a purple top hat, and hilariously excessive confidence. Its hat is the only prop. The single teaching glyph is Traditional Chinese 超, built from a verified textbook glyph outline: clearly preserve 走 wrapping the lower left and 召 at the upper right, including 刀 above the open interior of 口. Treat the letterform as one rigid, flat-fronted shape throughout.

At the opening, the rabbit stands below the center with its hat held upright, confidently displaying a tiny pinch between its fingers to promise a miniature trick. It reaches into the hat and tugs. Nothing happens. By 1.3 seconds it braces its feet and pulls with both paws, cheeks puffed. At 1.8 seconds, one small coral-red 超 rises vertically from the hat, centered and fully readable. The rabbit beams—then the glyph smoothly enlarges far beyond its intended size, reaching 70% of frame height by 3.2 seconds. Enlarge it uniformly, keeping its full silhouette centered, uncropped, and front-facing with generous margins; the rabbit's paws stay below the strokes. The hat's elastic rim briefly stretches beneath the glyph, then slips free and recoils downward onto the rabbit's head, covering its eyes while its ears poke out. Use a soft rubbery plop. The completed glyph now rests motionless at frame center. Below it, the rabbit freezes, lifts the brim with one finger, gives an astonished double-take at its enormous successful trick, then proudly bows and scoots out through the lower edge by 4.6 seconds. Keep the comic reaction entirely below the glyph, without covering any stroke.

From 4.6 to 8.0 seconds, hold completely still on the finished 超 alone, centered at approximately 70% of frame height. Maintain crisp solid-color strokes and clearly open negative spaces. Use bright, gentle colors without neon, glare, or flashing effects. All visual performers are unmistakably stylized animation. The only visible writing is the single 超; include no subtitles, vocabulary text, logos, or watermarks.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly 「超、超、超人」. Pronounce 超 as ㄔㄠ, with the first utterance around 0.5 seconds, the second around 1.5 seconds, and 超人 around 5.5 seconds during the clear final hold. Use natural pauses and stop after the word. The vocabulary is audio only. Keep the soft tug and hat-plop effects beneath the voice; use no music.
